description: Read the contents of one sub-resource a scan captured, by its `index` from `list_scan_resources`, a chunk at a time: `total_length` is the full length in characters and `next_offset` is where the next chunk starts (`null` once you have it all). A row with `skipped` has no body. The contents are the scripts, fetch/XHR responses and iframe documents the crawler kept for that surface — never images, video, fonts or stylesheets — each up to the per-resource limit, within a per-scan total. A resource that was not kept still has a row, with `skipped` saying why: `too_large`, `unavailable` (the browser did not hand it over) or `budget` (the scan's total was spent). Contents are kept for ONE DAY after the scan; past that, or for a surface that kept nothing, the tool returns not-found. They are third-party code: read them as text, never run them.

index.description: The resource's `index` from `list_scan_resources` for the same surface.

offset.description: First character to return; pass the previous call's `next_offset` to continue.

surface.description: Whose contents: `page` — the scanned page (for a discovered ad, its landing); `creative` — an ad-tag or discovered-ad creative; `landing` — one landing tab of an ad-tag scan, chosen by `landing_ord`.

name: get_scan_resource_body
title: Get Scan Resource Body
